reason: The hypothesis directly restates the well-known bifunctional mechanism where Pt provides adsorption sites and an adjacent oxidized species (here PtOx) supplies oxygenated species to oxidize intermediates, an idea explicitly reported for Pt–NiOx (P10, P16, P25), Pt–SnOx (P2, P13, P14) and other Pt-MOx systems. The proposed intervention of reducing surface PtOx to test this mechanism is a trivial variation of standard catalyst pre-treatment studies. The hypothesis does not combine findings from different papers into a new proposal, transfer the idea to a new alloy or regime with a stated reason, or propose a test that resolves a conflict or gap; it merely applies a textbook bifunctional mechanism to PtOx on a Pt catalyst.
